Title: Retirement: Azure Machine Learning SDK v1 Will Be Retired on June 30, 2026 – Transition to Machine Learning SDK v2

Body.Content:
Starting on June 30, 2026, Azure Machine Learning Software Development Kit version 1 (SDK v1) will no longer be supported.  


 Required action  

To avoid service disruptions, you’ll need to migrate to Azure Machine Learning Software Development Kit version 2 (SDK v2) before that date.

 

Azure Machine Learning CLI v2 and Azure Machine Learning Python SDK v2 (SDK v2) introduce a consistency of features and terminology across the interfaces. To create this consistency, the syntax of commands differs, in some cases significantly, from the first versions (v1). For more information please refer to our documentation and read Upgrade to v2.


More Information

If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A https://aka.ms/azureqa If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request. 

  1. For Issue type, select Technical.  
  2. For Subscription, select your subscription.  
  3. For Service, select My services, then select Machine Learning.  
  4. For Summary, type a description of your issue.  
  5. For Problem type, select SDK or CLI.  
  6. For Problem subtype, select Machine Learning CLI.  

Learn more about service retirements that may impact your resources in the Azure Retirement Workbook. Please note that retirements may not be visible in the workbook for up to two weeks after being announced.
